THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Declaration under Section 5

I, Nalaka Jude Harin Fernando, Minister of Tourism and Lands, hereby declare, under Sub-section (1) of Section 5 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the land described below is needed for a public purpose and will be acquired under the provisions of that Act.

An Allotment of Land depicted in below name and extent in the Advance Tracing No. MN/MNN/2023/521 dated 25.10.2023, Prepared by the Surveyor - General, situated in the Village Called Keeliyankudiyiruppu in the Grama Niladhari Division, No. MN/54 of Thullukudiyiruppu in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Mannar Town in Mannar District in Northern Province and bounded as follows:

01. Lot zAZ - Keeliyankudiyiruppukaani - Extent : 0.7809 Hectare North: Keeliyankudiyiruppukaani (claimant not known); East :Keeliyankudiyiruppukaani (claimant not known); South: Keeliyankudiyiruppukaani (claimant not known), Road (Road Development Authority) and Lot B; West : Lot B, Road (Road Development Authority) and Keeliyankudiyiruppukaani (claimant not known).
Harin Fernando, Minister of Tourism and Lands.
My Ref No. : 4-3/11/2023/RE/180.Ministry of Tourism and Lands,"Mihikatha Medura", Rajamalwatta Road,Battaramulla.01st February 2024.
